name: The 2nd Worst Interview She's Ever Had
source:
Play as an unfortunate hiring manager who comes face to face with a seemingly normal woman, who is definitely not hiding anything! And if she were, it would certainly be nothing demonic...

[From [url=https://leoniebeetle.itch.io/the-2nd-worst-interview-shes-ever-had]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一位倒楣的招募經理，與一個看似普通的女人面對面。她肯定什麼也沒瞞著你！就算她真有所隱瞞，也絕對不會牽扯到惡魔……
